To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) LXR ligands induce CYP3A in cultured rodent hepatocyte preparations, 2) LXR ligand-induced CYP3A expression in cultured hepatocytes is mediated via PXR, and 3) PXR is activated by LXR ligands in cultured hepatocyte preparations.
LXR ligands induce CYP3A in primary cultured rat hepatocytes through activation of PXR.
LXR agonists induce CYP3A in rodent hepatocyte cultures through activation of PXR.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the effects of the LXR ligand, 24(S), 25-epoxy-cholesterol on cytochrome p450 (CYP) 3A expression and the mechanism of this action.
a novel aspect of the biology of LXR, namely the ability to activate PXR and thereby induce CYP3A expression.
the effects of LXR ligands on CYP3As in rodent hepatocytes and the mechanisms involved.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LXR ligands induce CYP3A expression in rodent hepatocytes by activating the PXR, but not the LXR.
LXR ligands can induce CYP3A through PXR in rodent hepatocytes.
LXR ligands induce CYP3A through the activation of the PXR.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LXR ligands can activate both PXR and LXR.
the induction of CYP3A by LXR ligands in rodent hepatocytes is mediated through the PXR, whereas the effects of LXR on other P450s are likely to be direct.

the induction of hepatic CYP3A expression by the LXR ligand 24(S), 25-epoxy-cholesterol is mediated by the PXR in both rat and mouse hepatocyte cultures, whereas the induction of CYP3A by the PXR ligand rifampicin is not mediated by LXR.
The main takeaway from our work is that
LXR agonists are capable of inducing the expression of CYP3A in hepatocytes.
LXR ligands can induce CYP3A through the pregnane X receptors (PXR) pathway in primary cultured hepatocytes.
LXR ligands can be used as PXR activators in vitro.
